subject: Request: >20% hosted API concession for Cascade Biotech (3yr commit)
messages:
From: Dr. Elena Ruiz <elena@cascade.bio>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing ask and term question for Redwood Hosted API

Connor —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Cascade is gearing up to replace our existing NLU pipeline and we’re very close to selecting a partner. A few quick items from our leadership: we can commit to a 3-year usage contract with an expected steady state of ~1.6B tokens/month after the ramp. We need EU data residency, SOC2 evidence (you already noted you have this), and a predictable unit price.

To be candid, procurement is pushing hard on unit economics. Given the long-term value and the scale we’ll bring, we’re requesting a 30% list discount off your standard Hosted API usage rates (token generation + embeddings) and a three-month onboarding credit to help with PoC costs. If that is feasible, we can accelerate signatures in April and push traffic into production in Q3.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can entertain a discount in that range and any gating conditions? If you need financial or technical specifics, Tom (cc’d) can provide our forecast.

Best,
Elena
Dr. Elena Ruiz
Chief Data Officer, Cascade Biotech
From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: Dr. Elena Ruiz <elena@cascade.bio>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing ask and term question for Redwood Hosted API

Elena —

Appreciate the transparency and the clear commit signal. Short answer: 30% off list is outside our standard delegated discount authority for Hosted API; anything >20% requires an Exec-level sanction. I’ve pulled together a proposal we think balances Cascade's needs and Redwood's margin/operational constraints:

- Proposed concession: 28% off standard Hosted API per-token rates for generation & embeddings at committed volumes.
- Commitment: 3-year term with a minimum monthly commit of $60,000 (billed monthly).
- Ramp support: one-time onboarding credit equal to 2 months of the committed monthly minimum (applied within first billing cycle).
- Operational conditions: EU-region deployment with VPC peering, SOC2 evidence shared, quarterly usage & quality reviews, and right to revert to standard pricing if average monthly usage drops below 60% of committed minimum for 3 consecutive months.
- Legal/finance asks: standard revenue recognition via monthly invoices; we’d require revised T&Cs and a tailored SOW (attached draft).

Why 28%: it meets Cascade close-to-requested economics while keeping gross margin above our floor for Hosted API at the expected 1.6B token cadence. Ben — I’m looping you for margin checks and any backstops (eg. staged discounting or usage tiers).

Attachments: Cascade_SOW_draft.pdf; redwood_rate_table_q1-2028.xlsx

Next step: I’m requesting Exec approval to authorize the 28% concession under the conditions above so we can finalize the commercial paperwork. If approved, I’ll hand to Legal + Finance and aim for signature before end of April.

Thanks —
Connor O’Brien
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing ask and term question for Redwood Hosted API

Connor —

Quick notes from Deal Desk:
- Model checked against redwood_rate_table_q1-2028.xlsx — at 1.6B tokens/month the 28% concession pushes initial gross margin below typical Hosted API thresholds, but the 3-year commit + minimum monthly guarantee makes the economics acceptable over the term.
- Mitigations: require the onboarding credit be milestone-tied (1/2 on contract execution, 1/2 on completion of ramp plan) and include a 12-month floor where we maintain the concession only if usage meets the committed cadence.
- Suggest adding a step-down provision: 28% for months 1–18, then automatically move to 22% for months 19–36 unless an uplift clause triggers. This reduces long-term margin risk while remaining attractive to Cascade.

I endorse pursuing Exec approval but recommend we present the step-down structure as a condition to protect margin. If Marissa confirms, I’ll prepare the Deal Desk memo and an updated cost model for Finance.

Ben Carter
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: legal_ops@redwood.com, finance_ops@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 24 Mar 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: >20% hosted API concession for Cascade Biotech (3yr commit) — APPROVED (conditions)

Connor / Ben —

After reviewing the Deal Desk note and the attached cost model, I’m authorizing the concession with the following firm conditions:

1) Concession cap: 28% off public Hosted API list pricing for months 1–18 only.
2) Step-down: pricing moves to 22% off for months 19–36 unless Cascade submits updated forecast and usage exceeds 120% of the committed monthly minimum for any two consecutive quarters (in which case we can discuss extension).
3) Onboarding credit: capped at two months of committed minimum, disbursed 50% at signing and 50% on completion of technical ramp checklist (engineering verification required).
4) EU data residency and SOC2 evidence must be contractually confirmed; no production cutover until compliance items are validated.
5) Finance/legal must approve payment terms — no extended 90+ day payment terms; standard net-30 preferred.
6) De-allocation clause: if average monthly usage drops below 60% of committed minimum for 3 consecutive months after month 6, Redwood may revert to standard list pricing with 30 days notice.

Assuming Legal and Finance can turn the SOW and T&Cs within two weeks (Ben, please coordinate), this concession is approved. Connor — proceed to capture signatures and confirm onboarding schedule with Cascade. Please file the Deal Desk memo under the HubSpot link and tag me on the final contract when routed.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
[Quoted/forwarded material included in threads above where appropriate; attachments referenced: Cascade_SOW_draft.pdf (SOW outline), redwood_rate_table_q1-2028.xlsx (model), Cascade_security_summary.pdf (SOC2 snapshot).]
